Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::deleteLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(loanTerm)
	postcondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false or
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->excludes(loanTerm) and
		result = true
}
